<!-- WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_3_EXTENSION_GUIDE
Wayward MOD 3.3 / current official engine 2026-09-30, original state schema58.
Developer-only guide: does not change story, UI text, or game balance.

1. First read AGENTS.md, master rulebook and Wayward_MOD_v3.3_Handoff.md.
   User intent first. No unsolicited narrative/content-level edits. Old patches are
   not automatic authority to revert new official rules. This is NOT stable_baseline.

2. Rebuild from the hashed parent via src/mod33/build.cjs; patches must find exactly
   one intended anchor. qa/build33/patches.json contains full before/after text.
   Do not globally replace minified names/numeric constants. Official names below
   belong to this exact build and must be rediscovered on engine upgrades.

3. Storage ownership:
   - Native game state: official schema58. Attributes, relationships, original items.
   - m31Data(state): MOD schema1 (live enumerable Symbol.for('wayward.mod.v3.data')).
     m31Put returns an immutable state; m31Copy deep-copies only MOD data.
   - Serialized JSON/manual/day/automatic records store modData beside native state.
     Never add modData as a property INSIDE exported original state.
   - modData.settings.balance = active + optional pending {day,values}; modData.guests
     = share/customs/overrides/retired. Guild inventory/daily/staff/temps/trip/ending
     retain their existing owners. m31Load is the validating loader allowlist.
   - Rt: device-only hotkeys, theme, save page and media preferences. Audio blobs,
     object URLs and handles must not enter game saves. Session locks are runtime only.
   - Native re-export may drop modData: original progress compatibility does not
     promise MOD-only data retention through unmodified official re-export.

4. Module boundaries and safe disable semantics:
   - Guild/inventory/staff: src/mod31/core.js + actions.js. Pending paid trips/contracts
     must settle/refund/end correctly before any future module shutdown is added.
   - Endings: src/mod31/endings.js, existing per-ending flags. Official relationship
     and generic breakup behavior are independent; do not delete native breakup state.
   - Balance: src/mod33/balance.js; all numeric changes queue for next game day.
     m33Advance runs at midnight and morning transition; never evict current guests.
   - Guest templates: src/mod33/guests.js; debug edits, next generated visit only.
     Name is the native relationship identity. Deletion uses retired names, retains
     present customers and historical records. Pm/fy/g4 are the small adapter layer.
   - Editor/UI: src/mod33/editor.js + ui.js. Dispatch mod31 actions via re.dispatch;
     never mutate re.getState().state in place, or bypass undo/serialization.
   - Media: src/mod31/media.js + existing original image settings; device preferences.
     Themes: src/mod33/themes.js/themes.css; display-only, ten options.

5. Addon authors:
   Reuse the state/modData boundary and existing dispatcher/undo transaction model.
   This is a source integration guide, NOT a general JS addon installer or guaranteed
   plugin API. Unknown modData keys are NOT automatically preserved by m31Load.
   For additional data, define a namespaced field, default, validation/migration,
   include it in the loader, and test all save paths plus undo and OFF cleanup.
   Never append closures/DOM objects to saves. Do not reuse our schema version as
   your own data version. Preserve approved game text and mechanics outside scope.
   Authors maintain their addon compatibility, including upgrade/missing-addon cases.
   Our compatibility responsibility covers official/Korean/our MOD original progress.

6. Required verification before claiming success:
   actual original/MOD roundtrip + manual/day/auto save + undo; absent/malformed MOD
   data recovery; active scene/guest lifecycle tests for touched adapters; full reverse
   diff; real browser layout and media/GPU where available. Node VM component execution
   is NOT visual browser QA. Outstanding bugs are listed separately in the handoff.

END_WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_3_EXTENSION_GUIDE -->

<!-- WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_4_EXTENSION_GUIDE
Wayward MOD 3.4 / official engine 2026-09-30 / original schema58 + sibling modData schema1.
CURRENT developer entry point: AGENTS.md, master rulebook, Wayward_MOD_v3.4_Handoff.md.
Build: src/mod34/build.cjs from the exact hashed v3.3 parent. QA: qa/build34/.
The prior 3.3 extension guide is archived as WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_3_EXTENSION_GUIDE.
Its ownership/addon boundaries remain applicable; it is not the current build recipe.

New optional data: modData.settings.autoHire.{grandma,goblin,hunter}, booleans,
default false. m31Defaults and m31Load own defaults/validation. Original state is
unchanged. m31Action(op:auto_hire) preserves dispatch/undo. m34AutoHire uses
existing m31Hire, at most one auto contract per role/day in prep. The loader must
not charge or hire. A used same-day hunter contract also prevents auto re-hiring.
Turning OFF does not cancel paid contracts; later manual hiring is unchanged.

UI adapters: RPe shared header flow; M33Launchers shop/bag icons; M31App shop+hire
tabs, category filtering, stock labels, aligned numeric edits; M33Settings happy/bad
groups; M31MediaSettings accessible native file pickers; rI pencil independent of
image availability. Media request protocol/cache and ending prose are unchanged.

Stock changes belong only to m31Daily assortment counts. Saved current-day stock
is retained. Prices, per-product quantities, inventory limits and visitor merchants
are unchanged. Restock uses the existing per-save seed/day mechanism, not Math.random.

Confirmed editor corrections: blank/non-finite market input cannot reset prices;
over-capacity imported inventory permits reductions while blocking further additions.

Do not add arbitrary code/addon loaders or silently mutate story content. This is
still a draft pending independent review, not a newly approved stable baseline.
138 scoped test groups passed, including 15 real headless-browser checks; read the
handoff for exact limits. Live image GPU/server and real audio hardware unverified.

Read-only additions requested during UI review: LF wife name uses existing Hc
with M34WifeSummary/PF/L/Wa. BD applies it only to the visible primary wife.
Guest e3 and native player nF are unchanged. Click still opens wife details.
LF statistics tab uses m34StatsView/M34Statistics; no new persistent counters.
Economy reads goldEarnedToday/incomeBreakdownToday/recentDailyEarnings (Fhe=3),
customersServedToday and customersLostToday. These are NOT weekly profit or
all arrivals. Intimate summaries read only existing intimateHistory (rw cap200),
WP/wse/mb. Intermediate acts/positions and lifetime counts cannot be inferred.
A future MOD ledger/cumulative tracker needs the user-approved storage design;
see the pending design in the handoff before adding fields or event hooks.

END_WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_4_EXTENSION_GUIDE -->

<!-- WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_5_EXTENSION_GUIDE
Wayward MOD 3.5 / official 2026-09-30 / original schema58 + sibling modData schema1.
Current entry: AGENTS.md, Wayward_MOD_v3.5_Handoff.md, src/mod35/build.cjs.
Exact parent v3.4 SHA256 d96ac65551d1980182cb4bf674a2261f92831fbc966d34a6be87d42d7c305082.
Tooltip and encounter views are read-only. Minimal economy counters are scoped below.

M35WifeTooltip fits its actual rendered height within the viewport, supports scroll,
and uses Ei/_Me for the native one-open-tooltip lifecycle. M34WifeName and primary
visible-wife BD adapter use it. Hc/player/guest renderers and stat calculations stay unchanged.

M35PartnerRanking/m35PartnerRanking exclude the player and reuse native yse grouping,
then explicitly sort by record count. Ties share ranks; recency then identity decide
which three are shown. All other non-player records, including unidentified/stranger
groups, go into the remaining total. Top3 + remaining equals non-player record count.
M34Statistics inserts the ranking after period/summary controls. Period selection is
all/today/last7days/last30days over retained intimateHistory, not a lifetime counter.

User clarified lightweight economics: today/7/30-day selection and simple totals,
not a finance manager/calendar. Optional modData.statistics schema1 stores rolling30
{day,income,visitors,complete} rows plus startDay/startSlot/throughDay/currentIncome/seen.
Income observes deltas of native goldEarnedToday through $1/ip/Ga; m0 explicitly handles
morning reset. Wallet changes/expenses/cheats are not revenue. Midnight is a separate
calendar day even when native income counter continues through the night.
Ga preserves the exact native arrival body under m35BaseGa; seen IDs avoid nested hook
duplicates, room moves and resident returns. Collectors and staff are excluded.
_c starts a complete first day. m31Load starts partial tracking on older saves, validates
optional stats independently, and never counts load as arrivals. Existing native
recentDailyEarnings/intimateHistory are untouched. Never fabricate unrecorded history.
Original schema58 and outer modData schema1 are unchanged. All new data follows existing
JSON/manual/day/autosave/undo contracts; original re-export may drop it like other MOD data.

Parent guides document inherited features; only WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_5_MAP is current.
Live image/GPU, real audio, other unfinished ports remain outside this UI release.

END_WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_5_EXTENSION_GUIDE -->

<!-- WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_3_EXTENSION_GUIDE
Wayward MOD 3.3 / current official engine 2026-09-30, original state schema58.
Developer-only guide: does not change story, UI text, or game balance.

1. First read AGENTS.md, master rulebook and Wayward_MOD_v3.3_Handoff.md.
   User intent first. No unsolicited narrative/content-level edits. Old patches are
   not automatic authority to revert new official rules. This is NOT stable_baseline.

2. Rebuild from the hashed parent via src/mod33/build.cjs; patches must find exactly
   one intended anchor. qa/build33/patches.json contains full before/after text.
   Do not globally replace minified names/numeric constants. Official names below
   belong to this exact build and must be rediscovered on engine upgrades.

3. Storage ownership:
   - Native game state: official schema58. Attributes, relationships, original items.
   - m31Data(state): MOD schema1 (live enumerable Symbol.for('wayward.mod.v3.data')).
     m31Put returns an immutable state; m31Copy deep-copies only MOD data.
   - Serialized JSON/manual/day/automatic records store modData beside native state.
     Never add modData as a property INSIDE exported original state.
   - modData.settings.balance = active + optional pending {day,values}; modData.guests
     = share/customs/overrides/retired. Guild inventory/daily/staff/temps/trip/ending
     retain their existing owners. m31Load is the validating loader allowlist.
   - Rt: device-only hotkeys, theme, save page and media preferences. Audio blobs,
     object URLs and handles must not enter game saves. Session locks are runtime only.
   - Native re-export may drop modData: original progress compatibility does not
     promise MOD-only data retention through unmodified official re-export.

4. Module boundaries and safe disable semantics:
   - Guild/inventory/staff: src/mod31/core.js + actions.js. Pending paid trips/contracts
     must settle/refund/end correctly before any future module shutdown is added.
   - Endings: src/mod31/endings.js, existing per-ending flags. Official relationship
     and generic breakup behavior are independent; do not delete native breakup state.
   - Balance: src/mod33/balance.js; all numeric changes queue for next game day.
     m33Advance runs at midnight and morning transition; never evict current guests.
   - Guest templates: src/mod33/guests.js; debug edits, next generated visit only.
     Name is the native relationship identity. Deletion uses retired names, retains
     present customers and historical records. Pm/fy/g4 are the small adapter layer.
   - Editor/UI: src/mod33/editor.js + ui.js. Dispatch mod31 actions via re.dispatch;
     never mutate re.getState().state in place, or bypass undo/serialization.
   - Media: src/mod31/media.js + existing original image settings; device preferences.
     Themes: src/mod33/themes.js/themes.css; display-only, ten options.

5. Addon authors:
   Reuse the state/modData boundary and existing dispatcher/undo transaction model.
   This is a source integration guide, NOT a general JS addon installer or guaranteed
   plugin API. Unknown modData keys are NOT automatically preserved by m31Load.
   For additional data, define a namespaced field, default, validation/migration,
   include it in the loader, and test all save paths plus undo and OFF cleanup.
   Never append closures/DOM objects to saves. Do not reuse our schema version as
   your own data version. Preserve approved game text and mechanics outside scope.
   Authors maintain their addon compatibility, including upgrade/missing-addon cases.
   Our compatibility responsibility covers official/Korean/our MOD original progress.

6. Required verification before claiming success:
   actual original/MOD roundtrip + manual/day/auto save + undo; absent/malformed MOD
   data recovery; active scene/guest lifecycle tests for touched adapters; full reverse
   diff; real browser layout and media/GPU where available. Node VM component execution
   is NOT visual browser QA. Outstanding bugs are listed separately in the handoff.

END_WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_3_EXTENSION_GUIDE -->

<!-- WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_4_EXTENSION_GUIDE
Wayward MOD 3.4 / official engine 2026-09-30 / original schema58 + sibling modData schema1.
CURRENT developer entry point: AGENTS.md, master rulebook, Wayward_MOD_v3.4_Handoff.md.
Build: src/mod34/build.cjs from the exact hashed v3.3 parent. QA: qa/build34/.
The prior 3.3 extension guide is archived as WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_3_EXTENSION_GUIDE.
Its ownership/addon boundaries remain applicable; it is not the current build recipe.

New optional data: modData.settings.autoHire.{grandma,goblin,hunter}, booleans,
default false. m31Defaults and m31Load own defaults/validation. Original state is
unchanged. m31Action(op:auto_hire) preserves dispatch/undo. m34AutoHire uses
existing m31Hire, at most one auto contract per role/day in prep. The loader must
not charge or hire. A used same-day hunter contract also prevents auto re-hiring.
Turning OFF does not cancel paid contracts; later manual hiring is unchanged.

UI adapters: RPe shared header flow; M33Launchers shop/bag icons; M31App shop+hire
tabs, category filtering, stock labels, aligned numeric edits; M33Settings happy/bad
groups; M31MediaSettings accessible native file pickers; rI pencil independent of
image availability. Media request protocol/cache and ending prose are unchanged.

Stock changes belong only to m31Daily assortment counts. Saved current-day stock
is retained. Prices, per-product quantities, inventory limits and visitor merchants
are unchanged. Restock uses the existing per-save seed/day mechanism, not Math.random.

Confirmed editor corrections: blank/non-finite market input cannot reset prices;
over-capacity imported inventory permits reductions while blocking further additions.

Do not add arbitrary code/addon loaders or silently mutate story content. This is
still a draft pending independent review, not a newly approved stable baseline.
138 scoped test groups passed, including 15 real headless-browser checks; read the
handoff for exact limits. Live image GPU/server and real audio hardware unverified.

Read-only additions requested during UI review: LF wife name uses existing Hc
with M34WifeSummary/PF/L/Wa. BD applies it only to the visible primary wife.
Guest e3 and native player nF are unchanged. Click still opens wife details.
LF statistics tab uses m34StatsView/M34Statistics; no new persistent counters.
Economy reads goldEarnedToday/incomeBreakdownToday/recentDailyEarnings (Fhe=3),
customersServedToday and customersLostToday. These are NOT weekly profit or
all arrivals. Intimate summaries read only existing intimateHistory (rw cap200),
WP/wse/mb. Intermediate acts/positions and lifetime counts cannot be inferred.
A future MOD ledger/cumulative tracker needs the user-approved storage design;
see the pending design in the handoff before adding fields or event hooks.

END_WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_4_EXTENSION_GUIDE -->

<!-- WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_5_EXTENSION_GUIDE
Wayward MOD 3.5 / official 2026-09-30 / original schema58 + sibling modData schema1.
Current entry: AGENTS.md, Wayward_MOD_v3.5_Handoff.md, src/mod35/build.cjs.
Exact parent v3.4 SHA256 d96ac65551d1980182cb4bf674a2261f92831fbc966d34a6be87d42d7c305082.
Tooltip and encounter views are read-only. Minimal economy counters are scoped below.

M35WifeTooltip fits its actual rendered height within the viewport, supports scroll,
and uses Ei/_Me for the native one-open-tooltip lifecycle. M34WifeName and primary
visible-wife BD adapter use it. Hc/player/guest renderers and stat calculations stay unchanged.

M35PartnerRanking/m35PartnerRanking exclude the player and reuse native yse grouping,
then explicitly sort by record count. Ties share ranks; recency then identity decide
which three are shown. All other non-player records, including unidentified/stranger
groups, go into the remaining total. Top3 + remaining equals non-player record count.
M34Statistics inserts the ranking after period/summary controls. Period selection is
all/today/last7days/last30days over retained intimateHistory, not a lifetime counter.

User clarified lightweight economics: today/7/30-day selection and simple totals,
not a finance manager/calendar. Optional modData.statistics schema1 stores rolling30
{day,income,visitors,complete} rows plus startDay/startSlot/throughDay/currentIncome/seen.
Income observes deltas of native goldEarnedToday through $1/ip/Ga; m0 explicitly handles
morning reset. Wallet changes/expenses/cheats are not revenue. Midnight is a separate
calendar day even when native income counter continues through the night.
Ga preserves the exact native arrival body under m35BaseGa; seen IDs avoid nested hook
duplicates, room moves and resident returns. Collectors and staff are excluded.
_c starts a complete first day. m31Load starts partial tracking on older saves, validates
optional stats independently, and never counts load as arrivals. Existing native
recentDailyEarnings/intimateHistory are untouched. Never fabricate unrecorded history.
Original schema58 and outer modData schema1 are unchanged. All new data follows existing
JSON/manual/day/autosave/undo contracts; original re-export may drop it like other MOD data.

Parent guides document inherited features; only WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_5_MAP is current.
Live image/GPU, real audio, other unfinished ports remain outside this UI release.

END_WAYWARD_MOD_PARENT_3_5_EXTENSION_GUIDE -->

function M36MobileCurrentActivity(){
  const state=re(x=>x.state),wife=g(state),playerLoc=be(state),task=jF(wife,state);
  const text=state.phase==="prep"?wife.name+"은(는) 영업 준비를 돕고 있습니다.":wife.name+"은(는) "+task+".";
  const meta="현재 위치: "+M36MobileStatusLabel(playerLoc)+" · "+task;
  return u.jsxs("section",{className:"m36-mobile-current-activity",children:[
    u.jsx("div",{className:"m36-mobile-current-activity-title",children:"현재 활동"}),
    u.jsx("div",{className:"m36-mobile-current-activity-text",children:text}),
    u.jsx("div",{className:"m36-mobile-current-activity-meta",children:meta})
  ]});
}
function M36MobileStockStatus(){
  const state=re(x=>x.state),dispatch=re(x=>x.dispatch),[loanAmount,setLoanAmount]=Z.useState(1);
  if(state.phase!=="prep") return null;
  const needs=x8(state),priceInfo=l5(state),want=priceInfo.want;
  const totalNeed=dr.reduce((sum,key)=>sum+(needs[key]??0),0);
  const gold=state.economy?.gold??0,debt=state.economy?.debt??0,targets=state.supplyTargets??Ew;
  const prices=Ah(state),cost=Ki(want,prices),canBuySome=Rw(state,want,prices,gold),canBuy=Ki(canBuySome,prices);
  const shortOnGold=totalNeed>0&&gold<cost,loanMax=Math.min(gold,debt);
  const safeLoan=loanMax>0?Math.max(1,Math.min(loanAmount,loanMax)):0;
  const hasPrep=totalNeed>0||debt>0;
  if(!hasPrep)return null;
  const setTarget=(item,delta)=>dispatch({type:"set_supply_target",item,value:Math.max(0,(targets[item]??Ew[item])+delta)});
  return u.jsxs("section",{className:"m36-mobile-prep-compact shrink-0 px-1 pb-1",children:[
    u.jsxs("div",{className:"flex items-center justify-between px-1 py-1",children:[
      u.jsx("span",{className:"text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-400/90",children:"오후 영업 준비"}),
      u.jsxs("span",{className:"text-[0.6rem] text-stone-600",children:[gold,"골드"]})
    ]}),
    totalNeed>0&&u.jsxs("div",{className:"rounded border border-stone-700 bg-stone-800/45 overflow-hidden",children:[
      qu.map(({key,label})=>{
        const current=state.supplies?.[key]??0,target=targets[key]??Ew[key],deficit=Math.max(0,target-current);
        return u.jsxs("div",{className:"grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] items-center gap-1.5 px-1.5 py-1 border-b last:border-b-0 border-stone-800",children:[
          u.jsxs("div",{className:"min-w-0 flex items-center gap-1.5",children:[
            u.jsx("span",{className:"text-[0.68rem] text-stone-300 truncate",children:label}),
            u.jsxs("span",{className:"text-[0.62rem] tabular-nums text-stone-500 whitespace-nowrap",children:[current,"/",target,deficit>0?" (+"+deficit+")":""]})
          ]}),
          u.jsxs("div",{className:"flex items-center gap-0.5",children:[

/* Session-only edit transaction and inverse deltas. Never call the game's undo. */
var M310_EDIT={pending:new Map(),undo:null,writing:false,collect:null,revision:0,reset:0};
var M310_EDIT_CONTEXT;
function m310EditContext(){return M310_EDIT_CONTEXT??(M310_EDIT_CONTEXT=Z.createContext(false));}
function m310EditNotify(){M310_EDIT.revision++;window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod310-editor'));}
function m310UseEditor(){const [v,set]=Z.useState(M310_EDIT.revision);Z.useEffect(()=>{const f=()=>set(M310_EDIT.revision);window.addEventListener('wayward-mod310-editor',f);return()=>window.removeEventListener('wayward-mod310-editor',f);},[]);return v;}
function m310EditorAction(a){return a.type==='mod31'&&(['edit','editor','quick','quick_save','trait','traits_apply','debug','balance','market_edit','guest','editor_lock'].includes(a.op)||a.op==='settings'&&a.key==='skillLock');}
function m310Equal(a,b){if(Object.is(a,b))return true;if(!a||!b||typeof a!=='object'||typeof b!=='object'||Array.isArray(a)!==Array.isArray(b))return false;const keys=Reflect.ownKeys(a);return keys.length===Reflect.ownKeys(b).length&&keys.every(k=>Object.hasOwn(b,k)&&m310Equal(a[k],b[k]));}
function m310Delta(before,after,path=[],rows=[]){
 if(m310Equal(before,after))return rows;
 const object=x=>x&&typeof x==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x);
 if(object(before)&&object(after)){for(const key of new Set([...Reflect.ownKeys(before),...Reflect.ownKeys(after)])){if(!Object.hasOwn(before,key)||!Object.hasOwn(after,key))rows.push({path:[...path,key],before:before[key],after:after[key],hadBefore:Object.hasOwn(before,key)});else m310Delta(before[key],after[key],[...path,key],rows);}}
 else rows.push({path,before,after,hadBefore:true});return rows;
}
function m310RestorePath(s,path,value,exists=true){if(!path.length)return value;const [key,...rest]=path,out=Array.isArray(s)?s.slice():{...s};if(rest.length)out[key]=m310RestorePath(s?.[key],rest,value,exists);else if(exists)out[key]=value;else delete out[key];return out;}
function m310Locks(rows){M33_LOCKS.clear();for(const [id,row]of rows)M33_LOCKS.set(id,{...row});}
function m310Reload(silent=false){M310_EDIT.pending.clear();M310_EDIT.reset++;m310EditNotify();if(!silent)m36Notice('현재 값을 다시 불러왔습니다. 미적용 입력은 취소했습니다.','info');}

function m310EditInstall(){re.subscribe((next,prev)=>{if(next.state===prev.state||M310_EDIT.writing)return;const had=M310_EDIT.pending.size||M310_EDIT.undo;M310_EDIT.undo=null;m310Reload(true);if(had)m36Notice('게임 진행 또는 불러오기로 현재 값이 바뀌어 편집·복원 기록을 초기화했습니다.','info');});}
function m310Commit(actions){
 const e=M310_EDIT,store=re.getState(),before=store.state,locks=[...M33_LOCKS].map(([id,row])=>[id,{...row}]);
 if(before.gameOver){m36Notice('게임이 끝난 상태에서는 변경할 수 없습니다.','error');return false;}
 let out=before;
 try{for(const a of actions){if(!m310EditorAction(a))throw Error('지원하지 않는 편집 항목입니다.');
  if(a.op==='editor_lock'){const spec=m33Specs(out,a.target).find(x=>x.id===a.id);if(!m31Data(out).debug||!spec)throw Error('디버그 모드에서 가능한 항목만 고정할 수 있습니다.');if(a.value)M33_LOCKS.set(spec.id,{target:a.target,value:spec.value});else M33_LOCKS.delete(spec.id);}
  else{const serial=M36_NOTICE.serial;out=m36Action(out,a);if(M36_NOTICE.serial!==serial&&M36_NOTICE.tone==='error')throw Error(M36_NOTICE.text);}
 }
 }catch(err){m310Locks(locks);m36Notice(err.message||'적용하지 못했습니다. 입력값을 확인하세요.','error');return false;}
 const patches=m310Delta(before,out),locksChanged=!m310Equal(locks,[...M33_LOCKS]);
 if(!patches.length&&!locksChanged){m36Notice('변경 사항이 없습니다. 현재 값이나 적용 조건을 확인해 주세요.','info');return true;}
 e.writing=true;try{if(out!==before)re.setState({state:out});e.undo={after:re.getState().state,patches,locks};}finally{e.writing=false;}
 m310EditNotify();m36Notice('치트 적용 완료 · '+actions.length+'개 수정. 직전 치트 수정 되돌리기로 취소할 수 있습니다.');return true;
}
function m310EditorDispatch(a){
 if(M310_EDIT.collect){M310_EDIT.collect.push(a);return;}
 if(M310_EDIT.pending.size){m36Notice('입력 중인 수치를 먼저 적용하거나 현재 값 다시 불러오기로 취소하세요.','error');m310EditNotify();return;}
 m310Commit([a]);
}
function m310Apply(){const rows=[...M310_EDIT.pending.values()];if(!rows.length)return;
 const bad=rows.find(x=>x.error);if(bad){m36Notice(bad.error,'error');return;}
 let actions;M310_EDIT.collect=[];try{for(const row of rows)row.apply();actions=M310_EDIT.collect;}finally{M310_EDIT.collect=null;}
 if(m310Commit(actions))m310Reload(true);
}
function m310Undo(){const e=M310_EDIT,row=e.undo,s=re.getState().state;if(e.pending.size){m36Notice('미적용 입력을 먼저 적용하거나 현재 값 다시 불러오기로 취소하세요.','error');return;}
 if(!row||row.after!==s){e.undo=null;m310EditNotify();m36Notice('되돌릴 직전 치트 수정이 없습니다.','info');return;}
 let out=s;for(const p of [...row.patches].reverse())out=m310RestorePath(out,p.path,p.before,p.hadBefore);
 e.writing=true;try{m310Locks(row.locks);if(out!==s)re.setState({state:out});e.undo=null;}finally{e.writing=false;}
 m310Reload(true);m36Notice('직전 치트 수정만 되돌렸습니다. 게임 시간과 장면은 그대로입니다.');
}
function M310EditorFooter(){m310UseEditor();const h=m31H,e=M310_EDIT;return h('div',{className:'m310-editor-footer'},h(M36Feedback,{}),h('div',{className:'m310-editor-actions'},h('small',null,'미적용 '+e.pending.size),h('button',{className:'m31-button',disabled:!e.pending.size,onClick:m310Apply},'적용'),h('button',{className:'m31-button',onClick:()=>m310Reload()},'현재 값 다시 불러오기'),h('button',{className:'m31-button',disabled:!e.undo||!!e.pending.size,onClick:m310Undo},'직전 치트 수정 되돌리기')));}

var M38_MUSIC={audio:null,key:'',url:'',queue:[],signature:'',phase:'prep',paused:false,error:'',time:0,duration:0,playing:false,history:[],bag:[],timer:null,token:0,handle:null,folderMessage:'',busy:false,open:false,revision:0};
const M38_PHASES={prep:'영업 준비',service:'영업 중',closed:'영업 종료',bedroom:'침실',away:'외출'};
function m38MusicDefaults(){return{mode:'sequence',follow:true,continuousSource:'@all',selected:'',dock:'right',x:16,y:80,listOpen:false};}
function m38MusicPrefs(raw){const d=m38MusicDefaults();return{...d,mode:['repeat','sequence','shuffle'].includes(raw.mode)?raw.mode:d.mode,follow:raw.follow!==false,continuousSource:typeof raw.continuousSource==='string'?raw.continuousSource:d.continuousSource,selected:typeof raw.selected==='string'?raw.selected:'',dock:['left','right','floating'].includes(raw.dock)?raw.dock:d.dock,x:m31Num(raw.x??16,0,10000),y:m31Num(raw.y??80,0,10000),listOpen:raw.listOpen===true};}
function m38Notify(){M38_MUSIC.revision++;window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod38-music'));}
function m38MusicSet(patch){m31MediaSet('music',patch);}
function m38Keys(){return [...M31_AUDIO_FILES.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'}));}
function m38Sources(){const folders=new Set;for(const key of m38Keys()){const parts=key.split('/');parts.pop();while(parts.length){folders.add(parts.join('/')+'/');parts.pop();}}return [['@all','전체 음원'],...[...folders].sort().map(p=>['@folder:'+p,p+' · 하위폴더 포함'])];}
function m38Queue(source){const keys=m38Keys();if(source==='@all')return keys;if(source.startsWith('@folder:'))return keys.filter(k=>k.startsWith(source.slice(8)));return M31_AUDIO_FILES.has(source)?[source]:[];}
function m38Phase(s){return s.errandSession?'away':s.phase==='bedroom'?'bedroom':s.phase==='prep'?'prep':['service','last_call'].includes(s.phase)?'service':'closed';}
function m38Title(key){return key?.split('/').pop()||'선택된 음원 없음';}
function m38Time(sec){sec=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number.isFinite(sec)?sec:0));return Math.floor(sec/60)+':'+String(sec%60).padStart(2,'0');}
function m38Volume(){const a=M38_MUSIC.audio,p=m31Media().music;if(!a||M38_MUSIC.timer!==null)return;const left=a.duration-a.currentTime;a.volume=p.volume*(p.fade&&Number.isFinite(left)?Math.min(1,Math.max(0,left/2)):1);}
function m38Play(){const a=M38_MUSIC.audio;if(!a||!M38_MUSIC.url||M38_MUSIC.phaseMuted)return;const token=M38_MUSIC.token;a.play().then(()=>{if(token===M38_MUSIC.token){M38_MUSIC.error='';m38Notify();}}).catch(e=>{if(token===M38_MUSIC.token&&e.name!=='AbortError'){M38_MUSIC.error='재생 버튼을 눌러 주세요. 재생되지 않으면 음원 형식을 확인하세요.';m38Notify();}});}
function m38LoadTrack(key,fade=false){const m=M38_MUSIC,a=m.audio,url=M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(key);if(!a||!url)return;clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;const token=++m.token;const start=()=>{if(token!==m.token)return;a.pause();m.key=key;m.url=url;m.time=0;m.duration=0;m.error='';a.src=url;a.loop=false;a.volume=m31Media().music.volume;m38MusicSet({selected:key});if(m31Media().music.enabled&&!m.paused)m38Play();m38Notify();};if(fade&&!a.paused&&m31Media().music.fade){let left=10;const vol=a.volume;m.timer=setInterval(()=>{if(token!==m.token)return;left--;a.volume=vol*Math.max(0,left/10);if(left<=0){clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;start();}},200);}else start();}
function m38Reconcile(){
 const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music;if(!m.audio)return;
 const requested=p.follow?(p.map[m.phase]??''):p.continuousSource;
 const wasSilent=!!m.phaseMuted||!!m.disabled;
 m.phaseMuted=requested==='@off';m.disabled=!p.enabled;

 let source=requested||m.source||'',queue=m38Queue(source);
 if(!queue.length&&source!==m.source){source=m.source||'';queue=m38Queue(source);}
 const sig=source+'\n'+queue.join('\n');
 if(!queue.length){clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;m.token++;m.audio.pause();m.queue=[];m.signature='';m.key='';m.url='';m.time=0;m.duration=0;m38Notify();return;}
 if(sig!==m.signature){const old=m.signature;m.source=source;m.signature=sig;m.queue=queue;m.history=[];m.bag=[];const preferred=!old&&queue.includes(p.selected)?p.selected:queue.includes(m.key)?m.key:queue[0];if(preferred!==m.key||M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(preferred)!==m.url)m38LoadTrack(preferred,!!old);}
 else m.queue=queue;
 if(m.key&&M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(m.key)!==m.url)m38LoadTrack(m.key);
 else if(wasSilent&&!m.paused&&m.key)m38Play();
 m38Volume();m38Notify();
}
function m38Next(direction=1,ended=false){const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music,queue=m.queue;if(!queue.length||m.phaseMuted)return;let next;if(direction<0&&m.history.length)next=m.history.pop();else if(ended&&p.mode==='repeat')next=m.key;else if(direction>0&&p.mode==='shuffle'&&queue.length>1){if(!m.bag.length)m.bag=m38Shuffle(queue.filter(k=>k!==m.key));next=m.bag.shift();}else next=queue[(Math.max(0,queue.indexOf(m.key))+direction+queue.length)%queue.length];if(direction>0&&next!==m.key){m.history.push(m.key);if(m.history.length>100)m.history.shift();}m38LoadTrack(next);}
function m38Choose(key){if(M38_MUSIC.phaseMuted||!M38_MUSIC.queue.includes(key))return;M38_MUSIC.paused=false;if(!m31Media().music.enabled)m38MusicSet({enabled:true});m38LoadTrack(key);}
function m38TogglePlay(){const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music;if(m.audio&&!m.audio.paused&&!m.paused){m.paused=true;clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;m.token++;m.audio.pause();m38Notify();return;}m.paused=false;if(!p.enabled)m38MusicSet({enabled:true});m38Reconcile();m38Play();}

function m310EditContext(){return M310_EDIT_CONTEXT??(M310_EDIT_CONTEXT=Z.createContext(false));}
function m310EditNotify(){M310_EDIT.revision++;window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod310-editor'));}
function m310UseEditor(){const [v,set]=Z.useState(M310_EDIT.revision);Z.useEffect(()=>{const f=()=>set(M310_EDIT.revision);window.addEventListener('wayward-mod310-editor',f);return()=>window.removeEventListener('wayward-mod310-editor',f);},[]);return v;}
function m310EditorAction(a){return a.type==='mod31'&&(['edit','editor','quick','quick_save','trait','traits_apply','debug','balance','market_edit','guest','editor_lock'].includes(a.op)||a.op==='settings'&&a.key==='skillLock');}
function m310Equal(a,b){if(Object.is(a,b))return true;if(!a||!b||typeof a!=='object'||typeof b!=='object'||Array.isArray(a)!==Array.isArray(b))return false;const keys=Reflect.ownKeys(a);return keys.length===Reflect.ownKeys(b).length&&keys.every(k=>Object.hasOwn(b,k)&&m310Equal(a[k],b[k]));}
function m310Delta(before,after,path=[],rows=[]){
 if(m310Equal(before,after))return rows;
 const object=x=>x&&typeof x==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x);
 if(object(before)&&object(after)){for(const key of new Set([...Reflect.ownKeys(before),...Reflect.ownKeys(after)])){if(!Object.hasOwn(before,key)||!Object.hasOwn(after,key))rows.push({path:[...path,key],before:before[key],after:after[key],hadBefore:Object.hasOwn(before,key)});else m310Delta(before[key],after[key],[...path,key],rows);}}
 else rows.push({path,before,after,hadBefore:true});return rows;
}
function m310RestorePath(s,path,value,exists=true){if(!path.length)return value;const [key,...rest]=path,out=Array.isArray(s)?s.slice():{...s};if(rest.length)out[key]=m310RestorePath(s?.[key],rest,value,exists);else if(exists)out[key]=value;else delete out[key];return out;}
function m310Locks(rows){M33_LOCKS.clear();for(const [id,row]of rows)M33_LOCKS.set(id,{...row});}
function m310Reload(silent=false){M310_EDIT.pending.clear();M310_EDIT.reset++;m310EditNotify();if(!silent)m36Notice('현재 값을 다시 불러왔습니다. 미적용 입력은 취소했습니다.','info');}

function m310EditInstall(){re.subscribe((next,prev)=>{if(next.state===prev.state||M310_EDIT.writing)return;const had=M310_EDIT.pending.size||M310_EDIT.undo;M310_EDIT.undo=null;m310Reload(true);if(had)m36Notice('게임 진행 또는 불러오기로 현재 값이 바뀌어 편집·복원 기록을 초기화했습니다.','info');});}
function m310Commit(actions){
 const e=M310_EDIT,store=re.getState(),before=store.state,locks=[...M33_LOCKS].map(([id,row])=>[id,{...row}]);
 if(before.gameOver){m36Notice('게임이 끝난 상태에서는 변경할 수 없습니다.','error');return false;}
 let out=before;
 try{for(const a of actions){if(!m310EditorAction(a))throw Error('지원하지 않는 편집 항목입니다.');
  if(a.op==='editor_lock'){const spec=m33Specs(out,a.target).find(x=>x.id===a.id);if(!m31Data(out).debug||!spec)throw Error('디버그 모드에서 가능한 항목만 고정할 수 있습니다.');if(a.value)M33_LOCKS.set(spec.id,{target:a.target,value:spec.value});else M33_LOCKS.delete(spec.id);}
  else{const serial=M36_NOTICE.serial;out=m36Action(out,a);if(M36_NOTICE.serial!==serial&&M36_NOTICE.tone==='error')throw Error(M36_NOTICE.text);}
 }
 }catch(err){m310Locks(locks);m36Notice(err.message||'적용하지 못했습니다. 입력값을 확인하세요.','error');return false;}
 const patches=m310Delta(before,out),locksChanged=!m310Equal(locks,[...M33_LOCKS]);
 if(!patches.length&&!locksChanged){m36Notice('변경 사항이 없습니다. 현재 값이나 적용 조건을 확인해 주세요.','info');return true;}
 e.writing=true;try{if(out!==before)re.setState({state:out});e.undo={after:re.getState().state,patches,locks};}finally{e.writing=false;}
 m310EditNotify();m36Notice('치트 적용 완료 · '+actions.length+'개 수정. 직전 치트 수정 되돌리기로 취소할 수 있습니다.');return true;
}
function m310EditorDispatch(a){
 if(M310_EDIT.collect){M310_EDIT.collect.push(a);return;}
 if(M310_EDIT.pending.size){m36Notice('입력 중인 수치를 먼저 적용하거나 현재 값 다시 불러오기로 취소하세요.','error');m310EditNotify();return;}
 m310Commit([a]);
}
function m310Apply(){const rows=[...M310_EDIT.pending.values()];if(!rows.length)return;
 const bad=rows.find(x=>x.error);if(bad){m36Notice(bad.error,'error');return;}
 let actions;M310_EDIT.collect=[];try{for(const row of rows)row.apply();actions=M310_EDIT.collect;}finally{M310_EDIT.collect=null;}
 if(m310Commit(actions))m310Reload(true);
}
function m310Undo(){const e=M310_EDIT,row=e.undo,s=re.getState().state;if(e.pending.size){m36Notice('미적용 입력을 먼저 적용하거나 현재 값 다시 불러오기로 취소하세요.','error');return;}
 if(!row||row.after!==s){e.undo=null;m310EditNotify();m36Notice('되돌릴 직전 치트 수정이 없습니다.','info');return;}
 let out=s;for(const p of [...row.patches].reverse())out=m310RestorePath(out,p.path,p.before,p.hadBefore);
 e.writing=true;try{m310Locks(row.locks);if(out!==s)re.setState({state:out});e.undo=null;}finally{e.writing=false;}
 m310Reload(true);m36Notice('직전 치트 수정만 되돌렸습니다. 게임 시간과 장면은 그대로입니다.');
}
function M310EditorFooter(){m310UseEditor();const h=m31H,e=M310_EDIT;return h('div',{className:'m310-editor-footer'},h(M36Feedback,{}),h('div',{className:'m310-editor-actions'},h('small',null,'미적용 '+e.pending.size),h('button',{className:'m31-button',disabled:!e.pending.size,onClick:m310Apply},'적용'),h('button',{className:'m31-button',onClick:()=>m310Reload()},'현재 값 다시 불러오기'),h('button',{className:'m31-button',disabled:!e.undo||!!e.pending.size,onClick:m310Undo},'직전 치트 수정 되돌리기')));}


/* Device-only music controller. One HTMLAudioElement; no audio bytes in saves. */
var M38_MUSIC={audio:null,key:'',url:'',queue:[],signature:'',phase:'prep',paused:false,error:'',time:0,duration:0,playing:false,history:[],bag:[],timer:null,token:0,handle:null,folderMessage:'',busy:false,open:false,revision:0};
const M38_PHASES={prep:'영업 준비',service:'영업 중',closed:'영업 종료',bedroom:'침실',away:'외출'};
function m38MusicDefaults(){return{mode:'sequence',follow:true,continuousSource:'@all',selected:'',dock:'right',x:16,y:80,listOpen:false};}
function m38MusicPrefs(raw){const d=m38MusicDefaults();return{...d,mode:['repeat','sequence','shuffle'].includes(raw.mode)?raw.mode:d.mode,follow:raw.follow!==false,continuousSource:typeof raw.continuousSource==='string'?raw.continuousSource:d.continuousSource,selected:typeof raw.selected==='string'?raw.selected:'',dock:['left','right','floating'].includes(raw.dock)?raw.dock:d.dock,x:m31Num(raw.x??16,0,10000),y:m31Num(raw.y??80,0,10000),listOpen:raw.listOpen===true};}
function m38Notify(){M38_MUSIC.revision++;window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod38-music'));}
function m38MusicSet(patch){m31MediaSet('music',patch);}
function m38Keys(){return [...M31_AUDIO_FILES.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'}));}
function m38Sources(){const folders=new Set;for(const key of m38Keys()){const parts=key.split('/');parts.pop();while(parts.length){folders.add(parts.join('/')+'/');parts.pop();}}return [['@all','전체 음원'],...[...folders].sort().map(p=>['@folder:'+p,p+' · 하위폴더 포함'])];}
function m38Queue(source){const keys=m38Keys();if(source==='@all')return keys;if(source.startsWith('@folder:'))return keys.filter(k=>k.startsWith(source.slice(8)));return M31_AUDIO_FILES.has(source)?[source]:[];}
function m38Phase(s){return s.errandSession?'away':s.phase==='bedroom'?'bedroom':s.phase==='prep'?'prep':['service','last_call'].includes(s.phase)?'service':'closed';}
function m38Title(key){return key?.split('/').pop()||'선택된 음원 없음';}
function m38Time(sec){sec=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number.isFinite(sec)?sec:0));return Math.floor(sec/60)+':'+String(sec%60).padStart(2,'0');}
function m38Volume(){const a=M38_MUSIC.audio,p=m31Media().music;if(!a||M38_MUSIC.timer!==null)return;const left=a.duration-a.currentTime;a.volume=p.volume*(p.fade&&Number.isFinite(left)?Math.min(1,Math.max(0,left/2)):1);}
function m38Play(){const a=M38_MUSIC.audio;if(!a||!M38_MUSIC.url||M38_MUSIC.phaseMuted)return;const token=M38_MUSIC.token;a.play().then(()=>{if(token===M38_MUSIC.token){M38_MUSIC.error='';m38Notify();}}).catch(e=>{if(token===M38_MUSIC.token&&e.name!=='AbortError'){M38_MUSIC.error='재생 버튼을 눌러 주세요. 재생되지 않으면 음원 형식을 확인하세요.';m38Notify();}});}
function m38LoadTrack(key,fade=false){const m=M38_MUSIC,a=m.audio,url=M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(key);if(!a||!url)return;clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;const token=++m.token;const start=()=>{if(token!==m.token)return;a.pause();m.key=key;m.url=url;m.time=0;m.duration=0;m.error='';a.src=url;a.loop=false;a.volume=m31Media().music.volume;m38MusicSet({selected:key});if(m31Media().music.enabled&&!m.paused)m38Play();m38Notify();};if(fade&&!a.paused&&m31Media().music.fade){let left=10;const vol=a.volume;m.timer=setInterval(()=>{if(token!==m.token)return;left--;a.volume=vol*Math.max(0,left/10);if(left<=0){clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;start();}},200);}else start();}
function m38Reconcile(){
 const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music;if(!m.audio)return;
 const requested=p.follow?(p.map[m.phase]??''):p.continuousSource;
 const wasSilent=!!m.phaseMuted||!!m.disabled;
 m.phaseMuted=requested==='@off';m.disabled=!p.enabled;
 if(!p.enabled||m.phaseMuted){clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;m.token++;m.audio.pause();m38Notify();return;}
 let source=requested||m.source||'',queue=m38Queue(source);
 if(!queue.length&&source!==m.source){source=m.source||'';queue=m38Queue(source);}
 const sig=source+'\n'+queue.join('\n');
 if(!queue.length){clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;m.token++;m.audio.pause();m.queue=[];m.signature='';m.key='';m.url='';m.time=0;m.duration=0;m38Notify();return;}
 if(sig!==m.signature){const old=m.signature;m.source=source;m.signature=sig;m.queue=queue;m.history=[];m.bag=[];const preferred=!old&&queue.includes(p.selected)?p.selected:queue.includes(m.key)?m.key:queue[0];if(preferred!==m.key||M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(preferred)!==m.url)m38LoadTrack(preferred,!!old);}
 else m.queue=queue;
 if(m.key&&M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(m.key)!==m.url)m38LoadTrack(m.key);
 else if(wasSilent&&!m.paused&&m.key)m38Play();
 m38Volume();m38Notify();
}
function m38Next(direction=1,ended=false){const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music,queue=m.queue;if(!queue.length||m.phaseMuted)return;let next;if(direction<0&&m.history.length)next=m.history.pop();else if(ended&&p.mode==='repeat')next=m.key;else if(direction>0&&p.mode==='shuffle'&&queue.length>1){if(!m.bag.length)m.bag=m38Shuffle(queue.filter(k=>k!==m.key));next=m.bag.shift();}else next=queue[(Math.max(0,queue.indexOf(m.key))+direction+queue.length)%queue.length];if(direction>0&&next!==m.key){m.history.push(m.key);if(m.history.length>100)m.history.shift();}m38LoadTrack(next);}
function m38Choose(key){if(M38_MUSIC.phaseMuted||!M38_MUSIC.queue.includes(key))return;M38_MUSIC.paused=false;if(!m31Media().music.enabled)m38MusicSet({enabled:true});m38LoadTrack(key);}
function m38TogglePlay(){const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music;if(m.audio&&!m.audio.paused&&!m.paused){m.paused=true;clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;m.token++;m.audio.pause();m38Notify();return;}m.paused=false;if(!p.enabled)m38MusicSet({enabled:true});m38Reconcile();m38Play();}
function m38Seek(value){const a=M38_MUSIC.audio;if(a&&Number.isFinite(a.duration))a.currentTime=Math.max(0,Math.min(a.duration,Number(value)||0));}
function m38OpenMusic(){M38_MUSIC.open=!M38_MUSIC.open;m38Notify();}
function m38AudioFile(file){return file.type?.startsWith('audio/')||/\.(mp3|ogg|wav|m4a|flac|aac|opus)$/i.test(file.name);}
function m38Register(entries,roots=[]){const keys=new Set(entries.filter(x=>m38AudioFile(x.file)).map(x=>x.key));for(const[key,url]of M31_AUDIO_FILES)if(roots.some(root=>key.startsWith(root))&&!keys.has(key)){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);M31_AUDIO_FILES.delete(key);}let count=0;for(const {key,file}of entries){if(!m38AudioFile(file))continue;const old=M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(key);if(old)URL.revokeObjectURL(old);M31_AUDIO_FILES.set(key,URL.createObjectURL(file));count++;}M38_MUSIC.folderMessage=count?'음원 '+count+'곡을 연결했습니다.':'선택한 곳에서 음원을 찾지 못했습니다.';window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod31-audio-files'));m38Notify();return count;}
function m38HandleDB(write,handle){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const request=indexedDB.open('wayward-mod-music',1);request.onupgradeneeded=()=>request.result.createObjectStore('folders');request.onerror=()=>reject(request.error);request.onsuccess=()=>{const db=request.result,tx=db.transaction('folders',write?'readwrite':'readonly'),store=tx.objectStore('folders'),r=write?store.put(handle,'selected'):store.get('selected');let result;r.onsuccess=()=>result=r.result;tx.oncomplete=()=>{db.close();resolve(result);};tx.onerror=()=>{db.close();reject(tx.error);};};});}
async function m38ScanFolder(handle){if(M38_MUSIC.busy)return;M38_MUSIC.busy=true;m38Notify();try{const entries=[];let unavailable=0;const walk=async(dir,prefix)=>{for await(const [name,item]of dir.entries()){if(item.kind==='directory')await walk(item,prefix+name+'/');else if(/\.(mp3|ogg|wav|m4a|flac|aac|opus)$/i.test(name)){try{entries.push({key:prefix+name,file:await item.getFile()});}catch{unavailable++;}}}};await walk(handle,handle.name+'/');m38Register(entries,[handle.name+'/']);if(unavailable)M38_MUSIC.folderMessage+=' 일부 파일은 읽을 수 없습니다.';}catch{M38_MUSIC.folderMessage='폴더를 읽지 못했습니다. 사운드 설정에서 다시 선택하세요.';}finally{M38_MUSIC.busy=false;m38Notify();}}
async function m38RestoreFolder(){try{const handle=await m38HandleDB(false);if(!handle||M38_MUSIC.handle)return;M38_MUSIC.handle=handle;const permission=await handle.queryPermission({mode:'read'});if(permission==='granted')await m38ScanFolder(handle);else{M38_MUSIC.folderMessage='이전에 선택한 음원 폴더가 있습니다. 다시 연결을 누르세요.';m38Notify();}}catch{/* Optional permission memory; ordinary file input remains usable. */}}
async function m38Reconnect(){const handle=M38_MUSIC.handle;if(!handle)return;try{if(await handle.requestPermission({mode:'read'})==='granted')await m38ScanFolder(handle);else{M38_MUSIC.folderMessage='음원 폴더 접근이 허용되지 않았습니다.';m38Notify();}}catch{M38_MUSIC.folderMessage='사운드 설정에서 음원 폴더를 다시 선택하세요.';m38Notify();}}
async function m38PickFolder(fallback){if(typeof window.showDirectoryPicker!=='function'){fallback?.click();return;}try{const handle=await window.showDirectoryPicker({id:'wayward-mod-music',mode:'read'});M38_MUSIC.handle=handle;let remembered=true;try{await m38HandleDB(true,handle);}catch{remembered=false;}await m38ScanFolder(handle);if(!remembered){M38_MUSIC.folderMessage+=' 다음 실행에서는 폴더를 다시 선택해야 합니다.';m38Notify();}}catch(e){if(e.name==='AbortError')return;M38_MUSIC.folderMessage='이 환경에서는 아래 일반 폴더 선택을 이용하세요.';m38Notify();}}

function M36Feedback(){const [message,setMessage]=Z.useState(M36_NOTICE);Z.useEffect(()=>{const f=e=>setMessage(e.detail);window.addEventListener('wayward-mod36-notice',f);return()=>window.removeEventListener('wayward-mod36-notice',f);},[]);return m31H('div',{className:'m36-feedback '+message.tone,role:message.tone==='error'?'alert':'status','aria-live':'polite',key:message.serial},message.text);}

function M36Traits({search=''}){const 유지됩니다.'),h('p',{className:'m31-note'},"미보유는 현재 보유하지 않는다는 뜻입니다. 과거에 발견한 성향은 소멸 후에도 발견 기록에 남을 수 있습니다. 다른 성향을 편집해도 이 기록은 유지되며, 해당 성향이 다시 생기지는 않습니다."),error&&h('p',{role:'alert',className:'m36-warning'},error),stale&&h('p',{role:'alert',className:'m36-warning'},'편집 중 실제 성향이 변경되었습니다. 편집 취소를 눌러 최신 상태를 확인하세요.'),h('div',{className:'m33-traits'},Object.entries(M31_TRAITS).filter(([id,name])=>(id+' '+name).toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())).map(([id,name])=>h('section',{className:'m31-card',key:id},h('h3',null,name),h('small',{className:'m31-note'},id),h('div',{className:'m33-segment'},['미보유','보유 · 미발견','보유 · 발견'].map((label,value)=>{const next={...draft,[id]:value},blocked=value>0?m36TraitError(s,next):'';return h('button',{key:value,'aria-pressed':draft[id]===value,disabled:!!blocked,title:blocked||undefined,onClick:()=>{if(!blocked)setDraft(next);}},label);}))))));}
function M36QuickPopup({index,onClose}){const s=re(x=>x.state),dispatch=re(x=>x.dispatch),[draft,setDraft]=Z.useState(()=>m36QuickLoad(s,m31Data(s).settings.quickCheats).value[index]),h=m31H,ref=Z.useRef(null),focus=Z.useRef(document.activeElement),debug=m31Data(s).debug,options=m36QuickOptions(s),error=m36QuickValidate(s,draft,true),setAction=(i,value)=>setDraft({...draft,actions:draft.actions.map((a,j)=>i===j?value:a)});
 Z.useEffect(()=>{ref.current?.querySelector('input')?.focus();const key=e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();onClose();}if(e.key==='Tab'){const ns=[...ref.current.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),select:not([disabled])')];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===ns[0]){e.preventDefault();ns.at(-1)?.focus();}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===ns.at(-1)){e.preventDefault();ns[0]?.focus();}}};window.addEventListener('keydown',key,true);return()=>{window.removeEventListener('keydown',key,true);focus.current?.focus?.();};},[]);
 const fresh=()=>{dispatch({type:'mod31',op:'quick_save',index,reset:true});setDraft(m36QuickDefaults()[index]);};
 return oF.createPortal(h('div',{className:'m31-overlay m36-quick-overlay','data-m36-popup':true,onMouseDown:e=>{if(e.target===e.currentTarget)onClose();}},h('section',{className:'m31-modal m36-quick-modal',role:'dialog','aria-modal':true,'aria-label':'퀵 치트 설정',ref},h('header',{className:'m31-head'},h('strong',null,'퀵 치트 '+(index+1)+' 설정'),h('button',{className:'m31-button',onClick:onClose},'설정 닫기')),h('main',{className:'m31-main'},h('label',{className:'m36-name'},'버튼 이름',h('input',{value:draft.name,maxLength:40,onChange:e=>setDraft({...draft,name:e.target.value})})),h('div',{className:'m36-color-options',role:'group','aria-label':'버튼 색상'},Object.entries(M36_COLORS).map(([id,name])=>h('button',{key:id,className:'m36-color '+id,'aria-pressed':draft.color===id,onClick:()=>setDraft({...draft,color:id})},name))),h('p',{className:'m31-note'},'일반 모드는 기력·피로·기분·흥분도·취기·마나와 보급 수치만 선택합니다. 디버그 모드를 켜면 더 다양한 수치를 선택할 수 있지만 진행·균형에 문제가 생길 수 있습니다. 디버그 항목이 든 버튼은 디버그를 켠 상태에서 실행하세요.'),h('p',{className:'m31-note'},'성향 추가·삭제와 장면·이벤트 강제 변경은 퀵 치트에서 제외됩니다. 한 버튼에 최대 5개까지 설정하며, 저장만으로 실행되지는 않습니다.'),draft.actions.map((a,i)=>{const spec=options.find(x=>x.id===a.id);return h('div',{className:'m36-quick-action',key:i},h('label',null,'항목 '+(i+1),h('select',{'aria-label':'실행 항목 '+(i+1),value:a.id,onChange:e=>{const x=options.find(o=>o.id===e.target.value);setAction(i,{id:x.id,value:Math.max(x.min,Math.min(x.max,a.value))});}},options.filter(x=>!x.debug||debug||x.id===a.id).map(x=>h('option',{key:x.id,value:x.id,disabled:x.debug&&!debug||draft.actions.some((a,j)=>j!==i&&a.id===x.id)},x.label+(x.debug?' · 디버그':''))))),h('label',null,spec?.max===1?'0 끄기 / 1 켜기':'설정값',h('input',{type:'number','aria-label':'실행 값 '+(i+1)+' 삭제'},'삭제'));}),h('button',{className:'m31-button',disabled:draft.actions.length>=5,onClick:()=>{const x=options.find(x=>(debug||!x.debug)&&!draft.actions.some(a=>a.id===x.id));if(x)setDraft({...draft,actions:[...draft.actions,{id:x.id,value:x.max}]});}},'항목 추가 ('+draft.actions.length+'/5)'),error&&h('p',{role:'alert',className:'m36-warning'},error)),h('footer',{className:'m31-footer'},h('button',{className:'m31-button',onClick:fresh},'기본 샘플로 복원'),h('button',{className:'m31-button',disabled:!!error,onClick:()=>{dispatch({type:'mod31',op:'quick_save',index,row:draft});onClose();}},'퀵 치트 저장')))),document.body);}
function M36QuickButtons(){const s=re(x=>x.state),dispatch=re(x=>x.dispatch),[editing,setEditing]=Z.useState(null),h=m31H,rows=m36QuickLoad(s,m31Data(s).settings.quickCheats).value,options=m36QuickOptions(s);return h(Z.Fragment,null,h('div',{className:'m33-quick-grid'},rows.map((row,index)=>h('div',{className:'m36-quick-card '+row.color,key:index},h('button',{className:'m36-quick-run',onClick:()=>dispatch({type:'mod31',op:'quick',index})},h('strong',null,row.name),h('p',null,row.actions.map(a=>(options.find(x=>x.id===a.id)?.label??a.id)+' '+a.value).join(' / '))),h('button',{className:'m31-button m36-quick-edit','aria-label':row.name+' 설정',onClick:()=>setEditing(index)},'설정')))),editing!==null&&h(M36QuickPopup,{index:editing,onClose:()=>setEditing(null)}));}


function m36BaseAction(s,a){if(s.gameOver)return s;switch(a.op){
 case 'auto_hire':{if(!Object.hasOwn(M31_STAFF,a.kind)||typeof a.value!=='boolean')return s;const m=m31Copy(s);m.settings.autoHire={...m.settings.autoHire,[a.kind]:a.value};return m34AutoHire(m31Put(s,m));}
 case 'guest':return m33GuestAction(s,a);
 case 'editor':return m33Edit(s,a);
 case 'balance':return m33BalanceAction(s,a);
 case 'buy':return m31Buy(s,a);
 case 'hire':return m31Hire(s,a.kind);
 case 'use':return m31Use(s,a);
 case 'edit':return m31Edit(s,a);
 case 'quick':if(a.kind==='player')return{...s,player:{...s.player,stats:{...s.player.stats,energy:100,mood:100},fatigue:0}};if(a.kind==='wife')return P(s,w=>({...w,stats:{...w.stats,energy:100,mood:100}}));if(a.kind==='clear')return P(s,w=>({...w,stats:{...w.stats,arousal:0,mood:80},intoxication:{...w.intoxication,level:0}}));if(a.kind==='stock')return{...s,supplies:{food:30,beer:30,wine:30},readyFood:30,tavernCleanliness:100};return s;
 case 'settings':{let m=m31Copy(s);if(['ntr','rich','collector','notoriety','skillLock','autoPosition'].includes(a.key)&&typeof a.value==='boolean')m.settings[a.key]=a.value;else if(a.key==='richGold')m.settings.richGold=m31Int(a.value,1000,1e6);return m31Put(s,m);}
 case 'debug':{let m=m31Copy(s);m.debug=!!a.value;return m31Put(s,m);}
 case 'trait':{if(!Object.hasOwn(M31_TRAITS,a.id)||![0,1,2].includes(a.value))return s;const result=m36Traits(s,{...m36TraitValues(s),[a.id]:a.value});if(result.error)m36Notice(result.error,'error');return result.state;}
 case 'market_edit':{if(!m31Data(s).debug||(['price','stock'].includes(a.field)&&!Number.isFinite(a.value)))return s;const m=m31Daily(s),cat=m31Catalog(s);if(a.kind==='unlimited'){if(typeof a.value!=='boolean')return s;m.settings.unlimitedGuildStock=a.value;return m31Put(s,m);}if(a.kind==='reset'){m.daily=null;return m31Put(s,m);}if(a.kind==='labor'&&M31_STAFF[a.id]){if(a.field==='available')m.daily.labor[a.id].available=!!a.value;else if(a.field==='price')m.daily.labor[a.id].price=m31Int(a.value,1,1e6);}else if(cat[a.id]&&cat[a.id].kind!=='supply'){const row=m.daily.items[a.id]??{price:cat[a.id].price,stock:0};if(a.field==='price')row.price=m313Price(m31Num(a.value,1,1e7));if(a.field==='stock')row.stock=m31Int(a.value,0,999);m.daily.items[a.id]=row;}return m31Put(s,m);}
 default:return s;}}

/* v3.5: tooltip and encounter read-only UI adapters. Economy owned by economy.js.
 * Hc is deliberately untouched: only the new wife's tooltip needs measured fit.
 * Ei/_Me retain the native single-tooltip and delayed-dismiss conventions. */
function m35WifeTooltipBox(anchor, contentHeight, viewWidth, viewHeight, placement='below') {
 const margin=8, gap=6, width=Math.max(1,Math.min(300,viewWidth-margin*2));
 const clamp=(v,min,max)=>Math.max(min,Math.min(v,Math.max(min,max)));
 let left=anchor.left,top,maxHeight=Math.max(1,viewHeight-margin*2);
 const fitsRight=anchor.right+gap+width<=viewWidth-margin,fitsLeft=anchor.left-gap-width>=margin;
 if(placement==='side'&&(fitsRight||fitsLeft)) { left=fitsRight?anchor.right+gap:anchor.left-gap-width;top=anchor.top; }
 else { const below=viewHeight-anchor.bottom-gap-margin,above=anchor.top-gap-margin,useBelow=below>=contentHeight||below>=above;maxHeight=Math.max(1,Math.min(maxHeight,useBelow?below:above));top=useBelow?anchor.bottom+gap:anchor.top-gap-Math.min(contentHeight,maxHeight); }
 const height=Math.min(contentHeight,maxHeight);
 return {left:clamp(left,margin,viewWidth-width-margin),top:clamp(top,margin,viewHeight-height-margin),width,maxHeight};
}
function M35WifeTooltip({children,placement='below',className=''}) {
 const anchor=Z.useRef(null),panel=Z.useRef(null),timer=Z.useRef(),closer=Z.useRef(null),[opened,setOpened]=Z.useState(false),[box,setBox]=Z.useState(null),id=Z.useId();
 const close=Z.useCallback(()=>{clearTimeout(timer.current);setOpened(false);setBox(null);if(Ei===closer.current)Ei=null;},[]);closer.current=close;
 const measure=Z.useCallback(()=>{
  if(!anchor.current||!panel.current)return;
  const rect=anchor.current.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(rect.bottom<0||rect.top>window.innerHeight||rect.right<0||rect.left>window.innerWidth){close();return;}
  const next=m35WifeTooltipBox(rect,panel.current.scrollHeight+2,window.innerWidth,window.innerHeight,placement);
  setBox(old=>old&&Object.keys(next).every(k=>old[k]===next[k])?old:next);
 },[placement,close]);
 const show=Z.useCallback(()=>{clearTimeout(timer.current);if(Ei&&Ei!==closer.current)Ei();Ei=closer.current;setOpened(true);},[]);
 const delay=Z.useCallback(()=>{clearTimeout(timer.current);timer.current=setTimeout(()=>{if(panel.current?.contains(document.activeElement)||anchor.current?.contains(document.activeElement))return;close();},_Me);},[close]);
 Z.useLayoutEffect(()=>{
  if(!opened)return;measure();
  const observer=typeof ResizeObserver==='function'?new ResizeObserver(measure):null;
  if(panel.current){observer?.observe(panel.current);if(panel.current.firstElementChild)observer?.observe(panel.current.firstElementChild);}
  window.addEventListener('resize',measure);window.addEventListener('scroll',measure,true);
  return()=>{observer?.disconnect();window.removeEventListener('resize',measure);window.removeEventListener('scroll',measure,true);};
 },[opened,measure]);
 Z.useEffect(()=>{
  if(!opened)return;
  const outside=e=>{if(!anchor.current?.contains(e.target)&&!panel.current?.contains(e.target))close();},key=e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();close();}};
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',outside,true);window.addEventListener('keydown',key,true);
  return()=>{document.removeEventListener('pointerdown',outside,true);window.removeEventListener('keydown',key,true);};
 },[opened,close]);
 Z.useEffect(()=>()=>{clearTimeout(timer.current);if(Ei===closer.current)Ei=null;},[]);
 return m31H('div',{ref:anchor,className,onMouseEnter:show,onMouseLeave:delay,onFocus:show,onBlur:delay,'aria-describedby':opened?id:undefined,onClick:()=>close()},children,
  opened&&oF.createPortal(m31H('div',{ref:panel,id,tabIndex:0,className:'m35-wife-tooltip',style:box??{left:8,top:8,width:Math.min(300,window.innerWidth-16),maxHeight:Math.max(1,window.innerHeight-16),visibility:'hidden'},onMouseEnter:()=>clearTimeout(timer.current),onMouseLeave:delay,onFocus:()=>clearTimeout(timer.current),onBlur:delay,onClick:e=>e.stopPropagation()},m31H(M34WifeSummary,{})),document.body));
}


/* yse groups native records by partnerType + partner. Its native display order
 * places the player first, so ranking must explicitly sort by count instead.
 * Anonymous groups represent multiple people and cannot be ranked as one person. */
function m35PartnerRanking(records) {
 const selected=records.filter(r=>r&&r.partnerType!=='player');
 const identified=selected.filter(r=>r.partnerType!=='stranger'&&typeof r.partner==='string'&&r.partner.trim()!=='');
 const groups=yse(identified),number=v=>Number.isFinite(v)?v:-1,key=p=>p.partnerType+':'+p.partner;
 const sorted=[...groups].sort((a,b)=>b.total-a.total||number(b.lastDay)-number(a.lastDay)||number(b.lastSlot)-number(a.lastSlot)||key(a).localeCompare(key(b),'ko'));
 let rank=0;
 const top=sorted.slice(0,3).map((p,i)=>{if(i===0||p.total!==sorted[i-1].total)rank=i+1;return {...p,key:key(p),rank,share:selected.length?p.total/selected.length:0};});
 return {total:selected.length,unidentified:selected.length-identified.length,partners:sorted.length,top,rest:selected.length-top.reduce((n,p)=>n+p.total,0)};
}
function M35PartnerRanking({records}) {
 const v=m35PartnerRanking(records),h=m31H,percent=n=>(n*100).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:1})+'%';
 return h('section',{className:'m35-partner-ranking','aria-label':'만남 상대 TOP 3'},
  h('div',{className:'m35-ranking-heading'},h('h3',null,'다른 상대와의 만남 TOP 3'),h('span',{className:'m35-record-scope'},'남편 제외')),
  v.top.length?h('div',{className:'m35-ranking-cards'},v.top.map(p=>h('article',{className:'m35-rank-card',key:p.key},
   h('div',{className:'m35-rank-title'},h('span',{className:'m35-rank-number'},p.rank+'위'),h('strong',null,p.partner)),
   h('div',{className:'m35-rank-count'},h('b',null,p.total),h('span',null,'건'),h('small',null,percent(p.share))),
   h('div',{className:'m35-rank-track','aria-hidden':true},h('span',{style:{width:percent(p.share)}})),
   h('p',null,Number.isFinite(p.lastDay)?'최근 만남 '+p.lastDay+'일차':'최근 날짜 기록 없음')
  ))):h('p',{className:'m34-stat-note'},'선택한 기간에 순위를 매길 상대 기록이 없습니다.'),
  h('div',{className:'m35-other-total'},h('span',null,'그 외 상대 합계'),h('strong',null,v.rest+'건'),h('span',null,percent(v.total?v.rest/v.total:0))),
  h('p',{className:'m34-stat-note'},'선택한 기간의 남편 외 만남 '+v.total+'건 기준. 동률은 공동 순위이며 최근 만남순으로 최대 3명을 표시합니다.'+(v.unidentified?' 낯선 사람들·상대 미상 '+v.unidentified+'건은 개인 순위 대신 그 외 합계에 포함합니다.':''))
 );
}

/* Minimal rolling 30-day statistics, owned by sibling modData.statistics.
 * Native goldEarnedToday is an income counter, not wallet balance. Observe its
 * changes so spending/cheat edits are not called revenue. Morning reset is an
 * explicit boundary; a midnight tick alone does not reset that native counter.
 * New customer IDs count arrivals; existing residents, reloads and room moves do not.
 */
function m35EconomyDay(s){return Math.max(1,Number.isFinite(s.slot)?Go(s.slot):s.day??1);}
function m35CustomerIds(s){return [...new Set((s.customers??[]).filter(c=>c&&!c.isCollector&&c.id!=null).map(c=>String(c.id)))];}
function m35StatisticsStart(s,complete=false){const day=m35EconomyDay(s);return{schema:1,startDay:day,startSlot:s.slot??0,throughDay:day,currentIncome:Number.isFinite(s.goldEarnedToday)?s.goldEarnedToday:0,seen:m35CustomerIds(s),days:[{day,income:0,visitors:0,complete}]};}
function m35StatisticsLoad(raw,s){
 if(raw==null)return{value:m35StatisticsStart(s),invalid:false};
 try{
  const integer=(n,min,max)=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=min&&n<=max,day=m35EconomyDay(s);
  if(typeof raw!=='object'||raw.schema!==1||!integer(raw.startDay,1,day)||!Number.isFinite(raw.startSlot)||raw.startSlot<0||raw.startSlot>(s.slot??0)||!integer(raw.throughDay,raw.startDay,day)||!Number.isFinite(raw.currentIncome)||!Array.isArray(raw.seen)||raw.seen.length>100000||raw.seen.some(x=>typeof x!=='string'||x.length>200)||!Array.isArray(raw.days)||raw.days.length<1||raw.days.length>30)throw Error('statistics shape');
  let prev=0;const days=raw.days.map(r=>{if(!r||!integer(r.day,Math.max(raw.startDay,raw.throughDay-29),raw.throughDay)||r.day<=prev||!Number.isFinite(r.income)||!integer(r.visitors,0,1e7)||typeof r.complete!=='boolean')throw Error('statistics day');prev=r.day;return{day:r.day,income:r.income,visitors:r.visitors,complete:r.complete};});
  if(prev!==raw.throughDay)throw Error('statistics cursor');
  return{value:{schema:1,startDay:raw.startDay,startSlot:raw.startSlot,throughDay:raw.throughDay,currentIncome:Number.isFinite(s.goldEarnedToday)?s.goldEarnedToday:0,seen:[...new Set(raw.seen)],days},invalid:false};
 }catch{return{value:m35StatisticsStart(s),invalid:true};}
}
function m35ObserveEconomy(s,resetIncome=false){
 if(!s)return s;
 const m=m31Data(s),old=m.statistics;
 if(!old)return m31Put(s,{...m,statistics:m35StatisticsStart(s)});
 const day=m35EconomyDay(s),income=Number.isFinite(s.goldEarnedToday)?s.goldEarnedToday:0,ids=m35CustomerIds(s),known=new Set(old.seen),arrivals=ids.filter(id=>!known.has(id));
 if(day<old.throughDay)return m31Put(s,{...m,statistics:m35StatisticsStart(s)});
 const delta=resetIncome?0:income-old.currentIncome;
 if(day===old.throughDay&&delta===0&&arrivals.length===0&&income===old.currentIncome)return s;
 const days=old.days.filter(r=>r.day>=day-29).map(r=>({...r}));
 for(let d=Math.max(old.throughDay+1,day-29);d<=day;d++)days.push({day:d,income:0,visitors:0,complete:true});
 const row=days.find(r=>r.day===day);row.income+=delta;row.visitors+=arrivals.length;
 const statistics={...old,throughDay:day,currentIncome:income,seen:day>old.throughDay?ids:[...new Set([...old.seen,...ids])],days};
 return m31Put(s,{...m,statistics});
}
function m35EconomyView(s,period=7){
 const day=m35EconomyDay(s),length=[1,7,30].includes(period)?period:7,ledger=m31Data(s).statistics??m35StatisticsStart(s),rows=ledger.days.filter(r=>r.day>=day-length+1&&r.day<=day),targetDays=Math.min(length,day);
 return{day,length,rows:[...rows].reverse(),income:rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.income,0),visitors:rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.visitors,0),covered:rows.length,targetDays,partial:rows.length<targetDays||rows.some(r=>!r.complete),startDay:ledger.startDay,startSlot:ledger.startSlot};
}
function M35Economy({view}){
 const s=re(x=>x.state),[period,setPeriod]=Z.useState(7),v=m35EconomyView(s,period),h=m31H,money=n=>Number(n).toLocaleString('ko-KR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})+'g';
 return h('div',{className:'m35-economy'},
  h('div',{className:'m34-stat-tabs',role:'group','aria-label':'경제 통계 기간'},[[1,'오늘'],[7,'최근 7일'],[30,'최근 30일']].map(([n,label])=>h('button',{key:n,type:'button','aria-pressed':period===n,onClick:()=>setPeriod(n)},label))),
  h('div',{className:'m34-stat-cards'},[['기록된 수입',money(v.income)],['방문 손님',v.visitors+'건'],['집계한 날짜',v.covered+'일'],['보유 골드',money(s.economy.gold)]].map(([label,value])=>h('div',{className:'m34-stat-card',key:label},h('span',null,label),h('strong',null,value)))),

/* Session-only edit transaction and inverse deltas. Never call the game's undo. */
var M310_EDIT={pending:new Map(),undo:null,writing:false,collect:null,revision:0,reset:0};
var M310_EDIT_CONTEXT;
function m310EditContext(){return M310_EDIT_CONTEXT??(M310_EDIT_CONTEXT=Z.createContext(false));}
function m310EditNotify(){M310_EDIT.revision++;window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod310-editor'));}
function m310UseEditor(){const [v,set]=Z.useState(M310_EDIT.revision);Z.useEffect(()=>{const f=()=>set(M310_EDIT.revision);window.addEventListener('wayward-mod310-editor',f);return()=>window.removeEventListener('wayward-mod310-editor',f);},[]);return v;}
function m310EditorAction(a){return a.type==='mod31'&&(['edit','editor','quick','quick_save','trait','traits_apply','debug','balance','market_edit','guest','editor_lock'].includes(a.op)||a.op==='settings'&&a.key==='skillLock');}
function m310Equal(a,b){if(Object.is(a,b))return true;if(!a||!b||typeof a!=='object'||typeof b!=='object'||Array.isArray(a)!==Array.isArray(b))return false;const keys=Reflect.ownKeys(a);return keys.length===Reflect.ownKeys(b).length&&keys.every(k=>Object.hasOwn(b,k)&&m310Equal(a[k],b[k]));}
function m310Delta(before,after,path=[],rows=[]){
 if(m310Equal(before,after))return rows;
 const object=x=>x&&typeof x==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x);
 if(object(before)&&object(after)){for(const key of new Set([...Reflect.ownKeys(before),...Reflect.ownKeys(after)])){if(!Object.hasOwn(before,key)||!Object.hasOwn(after,key))rows.push({path:[...path,key],before:before[key],after:after[key],hadBefore:Object.hasOwn(before,key)});else m310Delta(before[key],after[key],[...path,key],rows);}}
 else rows.push({path,before,after,hadBefore:true});return rows;
}
function m310RestorePath(s,path,value,exists=true){if(!path.length)return value;const [key,...rest]=path,out=Array.isArray(s)?s.slice():{...s};if(rest.length)out[key]=m310RestorePath(s?.[key],rest,value,exists);else if(exists)out[key]=value;else delete out[key];return out;}
function m310Locks(rows){M33_LOCKS.clear();for(const [id,row]of rows)M33_LOCKS.set(id,{...row});}
function m310Reload(silent=false){M310_EDIT.pending.clear();M310_EDIT.reset++;m310EditNotify();if(!silent)m36Notice('현재 값을 다시 불러왔습니다. 미적용 입력은 취소했습니다.','info');}

function m310EditInstall(){re.subscribe((next,prev)=>{if(next.state===prev.state||M310_EDIT.writing)return;const had=M310_EDIT.pending.size||M310_EDIT.undo;M310_EDIT.undo=null;m310Reload(true);if(had)m36Notice('게임 진행 또는 불러오기로 현재 값이 바뀌어 편집·복원 기록을 초기화했습니다.','info');});}
function m310Commit(actions){
 const e=M310_EDIT,store=re.getState(),before=store.state,locks=[...M33_LOCKS].map(([id,row])=>[id,{...row}]);
 if(before.gameOver){m36Notice('게임이 끝난 상태에서는 변경할 수 없습니다.','error');return false;}
 let out=before;
 try{for(const a of actions){if(!m310EditorAction(a))throw Error('지원하지 않는 편집 항목입니다.');
  if(a.op==='editor_lock'){const spec=m33Specs(out,a.target).find(x=>x.id===a.id);if(!m31Data(out).debug||!spec)throw Error('디버그 모드에서 가능한 항목만 고정할 수 있습니다.');if(a.value)M33_LOCKS.set(spec.id,{target:a.target,value:spec.value});else M33_LOCKS.delete(spec.id);}
  else{const serial=M36_NOTICE.serial;out=m36Action(out,a);if(M36_NOTICE.serial!==serial&&M36_NOTICE.tone==='error')throw Error(M36_NOTICE.text);}
 }
 }catch(err){m310Locks(locks);m36Notice(err.message||'적용하지 못했습니다. 입력값을 확인하세요.','error');return false;}
 const patches=m310Delta(before,out),locksChanged=!m310Equal(locks,[...M33_LOCKS]);
 if(!patches.length&&!locksChanged){m36Notice('변경 사항이 없습니다. 현재 값이나 적용 조건을 확인해 주세요.','info');return true;}
 e.writing=true;try{if(out!==before)re.setState({state:out});e.undo={after:re.getState().state,patches,locks};}finally{e.writing=false;}
 m310EditNotify();m36Notice('치트 적용 완료 · '+actions.length+'개 수정. 직전 치트 수정 되돌리기로 취소할 수 있습니다.');return true;
}
function m310EditorDispatch(a){
 if(M310_EDIT.collect){M310_EDIT.collect.push(a);return;}
 if(M310_EDIT.pending.size){m36Notice('입력 중인 수치를 먼저 적용하거나 현재 값 다시 불러오기로 취소하세요.','error');m310EditNotify();return;}
 m310Commit([a]);
}
function m310Apply(){const rows=[...M310_EDIT.pending.values()];if(!rows.length)return;
 const bad=rows.find(x=>x.error);if(bad){m36Notice(bad.error,'error');return;}
 let actions;M310_EDIT.collect=[];try{for(const row of rows)row.apply();actions=M310_EDIT.collect;}finally{M310_EDIT.collect=null;}
 if(m310Commit(actions))m310Reload(true);
}
function m310Undo(){const e=M310_EDIT,row=e.undo,s=re.getState().state;if(e.pending.size){m36Notice('미적용 입력을 먼저 적용하거나 현재 값 다시 불러오기로 취소하세요.','error');return;}
 if(!row||row.after!==s){e.undo=null;m310EditNotify();m36Notice('되돌릴 직전 치트 수정이 없습니다.','info');return;}

}

var M38_MUSIC={audio:null,key:'',url:'',queue:[],signature:'',phase:'prep',paused:false,error:'',time:0,duration:0,playing:false,history:[],bag:[],timer:null,token:0,handle:null,folderMessage:'',busy:false,open:false,revision:0};
const M38_PHASES={prep:'영업 준비',service:'영업 중',closed:'영업 종료',bedroom:'침실',away:'외출'};
function m38MusicDefaults(){return{mode:'sequence',follow:true,continuousSource:'@all',selected:'',dock:'right',x:16,y:80,listOpen:false};}
function m38MusicPrefs(raw){const d=m38MusicDefaults();return{...d,mode:['repeat','sequence','shuffle'].includes(raw.mode)?raw.mode:d.mode,follow:raw.follow!==false,continuousSource:typeof raw.continuousSource==='string'?raw.continuousSource:d.continuousSource,selected:typeof raw.selected==='string'?raw.selected:'',dock:['left','right','floating'].includes(raw.dock)?raw.dock:d.dock,x:m31Num(raw.x??16,0,10000),y:m31Num(raw.y??80,0,10000),listOpen:raw.listOpen===true};}
function m38Notify(){M38_MUSIC.revision++;window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod38-music'));}
function m38MusicSet(patch){m31MediaSet('music',patch);}
function m38Keys(){return [...M31_AUDIO_FILES.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true,sensitivity:'base'}));}
function m38Sources(){const folders=new Set;for(const key of m38Keys()){const parts=key.split('/');parts.pop();while(parts.length){folders.add(parts.join('/')+'/');parts.pop();}}return [['@all','전체 음원'],...[...folders].sort().map(p=>['@folder:'+p,p+' · 하위폴더 포함'])];}
function m38Queue(source){const keys=m38Keys();if(source==='@all')return keys;if(source.startsWith('@folder:'))return keys.filter(k=>k.startsWith(source.slice(8)));return M31_AUDIO_FILES.has(source)?[source]:[];}
function m38Phase(s){return s.errandSession?'away':s.phase==='bedroom'?'bedroom':s.phase==='prep'?'prep':['service','last_call'].includes(s.phase)?'service':'closed';}
function m38Title(key){return key?.split('/').pop()||'선택된 음원 없음';}
function m38Time(sec){sec=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number.isFinite(sec)?sec:0));return Math.floor(sec/60)+':'+String(sec%60).padStart(2,'0');}
function m38Volume(){const a=M38_MUSIC.audio,p=m31Media().music;if(!a||M38_MUSIC.timer!==null)return;const left=a.duration-a.currentTime;a.volume=p.volume*(p.fade&&Number.isFinite(left)?Math.min(1,Math.max(0,left/2)):1);}
function m38Play(){const a=M38_MUSIC.audio;if(!a||!M38_MUSIC.url||M38_MUSIC.phaseMuted)return;const token=M38_MUSIC.token;a.play().then(()=>{if(token===M38_MUSIC.token){M38_MUSIC.error='';m38Notify();}}).catch(e=>{if(token===M38_MUSIC.token&&e.name!=='AbortError'){M38_MUSIC.error='재생 버튼을 눌러 주세요. 재생되지 않으면 음원 형식을 확인하세요.';m38Notify();}});}
function m38LoadTrack(key,fade=false){const m=M38_MUSIC,a=m.audio,url=M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(key);if(!a||!url)return;clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;const token=++m.token;const start=()=>{if(token!==m.token)return;a.pause();m.key=key;m.url=url;m.time=0;m.duration=0;m.error='';a.src=url;a.loop=false;a.volume=m31Media().music.volume;m38MusicSet({selected:key});if(m31Media().music.enabled&&!m.paused)m38Play();m38Notify();};if(fade&&!a.paused&&m31Media().music.fade){let left=10;const vol=a.volume;m.timer=setInterval(()=>{if(token!==m.token)return;left--;a.volume=vol*Math.max(0,left/10);if(left<=0){clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;start();}},200);}else start();}
function m38Reconcile(){
 const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music;if(!m.audio)return;
 const requested=p.follow?(p.map[m.phase]??''):p.continuousSource;
 const wasSilent=!!m.phaseMuted||!!m.disabled;

 if(!queue.length&&source!==m.source){source=m.source||'';queue=m38Queue(source);}
 const sig=source+'\n'+queue.join('\n');
 if(!queue.length){clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;m.token++;m.audio.pause();m.queue=[];m.signature='';m.key='';m.url='';m.time=0;m.duration=0;m38Notify();return;}
 if(sig!==m.signature){const old=m.signature;m.source=source;m.signature=sig;m.queue=queue;m.history=[];m.bag=[];const preferred=!old&&queue.includes(p.selected)?p.selected:queue.includes(m.key)?m.key:queue[0];if(preferred!==m.key||M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(preferred)!==m.url)m38LoadTrack(preferred,!!old);}
 else m.queue=queue;
 if(m.key&&M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(m.key)!==m.url)m38LoadTrack(m.key);
 else if(wasSilent&&!m.paused&&m.key)m38Play();
 m38Volume();m38Notify();
}
function m38Next(direction=1,ended=false){const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music,queue=m.queue;if(!queue.length||m.phaseMuted)return;let next;if(direction<0&&m.history.length)next=m.history.pop();else if(ended&&p.mode==='repeat')next=m.key;else if(direction>0&&p.mode==='shuffle'&&queue.length>1){if(!m.bag.length)m.bag=m38Shuffle(queue.filter(k=>k!==m.key));next=m.bag.shift();}else next=queue[(Math.max(0,queue.indexOf(m.key))+direction+queue.length)%queue.length];if(direction>0&&next!==m.key){m.history.push(m.key);if(m.history.length>100)m.history.shift();}m38LoadTrack(next);}
function m38Choose(key){if(M38_MUSIC.phaseMuted||!M38_MUSIC.queue.includes(key))return;M38_MUSIC.paused=false;if(!m31Media().music.enabled)m38MusicSet({enabled:true});m38LoadTrack(key);}
function m38TogglePlay(){const m=M38_MUSIC,p=m31Media().music;if(m.audio&&!m.audio.paused&&!m.paused){m.paused=true;clearInterval(m.timer);m.timer=null;m.token++;m.audio.pause();m38Notify();return;}m.paused=false;if(!p.enabled)m38MusicSet({enabled:true});m38Reconcile();m38Play();}

function m38Register(entries,roots=[]){const keys=new Set(entries.filter(x=>m38AudioFile(x.file)).map(x=>x.key));for(const[key,url]of M31_AUDIO_FILES)if(roots.some(root=>key.startsWith(root))&&!keys.has(key)){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);M31_AUDIO_FILES.delete(key);}let count=0;for(const {key,file}of entries){if(!m38AudioFile(file))continue;const old=M31_AUDIO_FILES.get(key);if(old)URL.revokeObjectURL(old);M31_AUDIO_FILES.set(key,URL.createObjectURL(file));count++;}M38_MUSIC.folderMessage=count?'음원 '+count+'곡을 연결했습니다.':'선택한 곳에서 음원을 찾지 못했습니다.';window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayward-mod31-audio-files'));m38Notify();return count;}
